name: filesystem-mcp
description: Filesystem MCP server for AI assistants.
long_description: Reads, writes, searches, diffs, and patches files inside the directories you choose. Paths outside those directories are refused unless you approve access when asked, and sensitive files such as `.env`, `*.pem`, and SSH keys are denied by default. Content search uses RE2, so no pattern can hang the server. Requires Node.js 24 or later.

tools.name: list_roots
tools.description: List the allowed directories. Call this first.

tools.name: list
tools.description: List directory contents as entries and an ASCII tree.

tools.name: find_files
tools.description: Find files by glob pattern, such as **/*.ts.

tools.name: stat
tools.description: Get size, modified time, permissions, MIME type, and a token estimate.

tools.name: search_text
tools.description: Search file contents with RE2 regex or literal text.

tools.name: diff
tools.description: Compare two files as a unified diff.

tools.name: read
tools.description: Read text files whole, by line range, head, or tail.

tools.name: create
tools.description: Create, overwrite, or append to text files, or make empty directories.

tools.name: edit
tools.description: Apply literal string replacements to files.

tools.name: move
tools.description: Move, rename, or copy files and directories.

tools.name: replace_text
tools.description: Search and replace across files matching a glob.

tools.name: patch
tools.description: Apply a unified diff to one file.

tools.name: undo
tools.description: Revert earlier file changes by undo id or the last N calls.

allowed_directories.title: Allowed directories
allowed_directories.description: Directories the server may read and write. Other paths need your approval first.

read_only.title: Read-only mode
read_only.description: Remove every tool that changes files. The AI can still list, search, and read.

deny_patterns.title: Extra blocked files
deny_patterns.description: Comma-separated patterns to block, for example private/**,*.sqlite. Secret files such as .env and private keys are already blocked.
